notes: DCGAN uses strided convolutions in the discriminator and fractional-strided convolutions in the generator, with batch normalization and ReLU activations. Added 2026-09-17 on explicit statements in the paper -- tanh: "the output layer which uses the Tanh function"; leakyrelu: "Use LeakyReLU activation in the discriminator for all layers."; sigmoid: "the last convolution layer is flattened and then fed into a single sigmoid output"; flatten: "the last convolution layer is flattened and then fed into a single sigmoid output".
